overall: The AG found an individual Open Meeting Law violation by a Committee member whose Feb. 2011 emails to all members expressed opinions on pending bylaw language. The Committee as a whole was not found in violation because no member responded. Only a reminder issued.

allegations.summary: A committee member allegedly used emails to all committee members to influence bylaw wording, deliberating outside a meeting (Feb. 6 and Feb. 15, 2011 emails).
allegations.key_passage: Here, Ms. McAuliffe's communications violated the Open Meeting Law's express prohibition on the dissemination of opinions to a quorum of other members outside of a meeting.

allegations.summary: Alleged that the Committee as a whole violated the Open Meeting Law through the emails sent to all members.
allegations.key_passage: Because no other dialogue or exchange of opinions resulted between or among a quorum of the Committee, the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Reminder to the individual member of her obligation to comply with the Open Meeting Law (no formal order).
Encouragement that all Committee members review the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law Guide to avoid future violations (no formal order).
remedy_passage: We remind Ms. McAuliffe of her obligation to comply with the requirements of the Open Meeting Law.
